# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 15 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of the Covenant

---

**15:1** 'After the transgression, God said to me: "Because you listened to your wife and ate from the tree I commanded you not to eat from, cursed is the ground because of your works. In toil and the sweat of your face you shall eat bread all the days of your life."'

**15:2** 'The Lord God made garments of skins for me and for my wife Eve, and he clothed us.'

**15:3** 'He said: "Behold, Adam has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out and take also from the tree of life and eat and live forever." And he sent us out of paradise.'

**15:4** 'At the gate of paradise he placed cherubim and a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree of life.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
